hmacsha256-hashdata.title: Compute HMAC-SHA256 with HMACSHA256.HashData
hmacsha256-hashdata.short: Calculate a keyed SHA-256 tag in one call
hmacsha256-hashdata.summary: HMACSHA256.HashData computes an HMAC-SHA256 tag from a key and input data.
hmacsha256-hashdata.why: Small payloads can be authenticated without constructing a stateful hashing object.
hmacsha256-hashdata.tips: When verifying tags, use FixedTimeEquals rather than ordinary SequenceEqual.

biginteger-modpow.title: Compute modular powers with BigInteger.ModPow
biginteger-modpow.short: Calculate a huge power modulo n without materializing the power
biginteger-modpow.summary: ModPow computes value^exponent mod modulus without first constructing the enormous full power.
biginteger-modpow.why: It directly represents modular exponentiation used in number-theoretic algorithms.
biginteger-modpow.tips: Do not build cryptographic protocols from arithmetic primitives alone; use established cryptographic APIs.

bitoperations-rotateleft.title: Rotate bits with BitOperations.RotateLeft
bitoperations-rotateleft.short: Move shifted-out bits back around to the other side
bitoperations-rotateleft.summary: RotateLeft circularly rotates an integer bit pattern by a requested amount.
bitoperations-rotateleft.why: It expresses rotations used by hashes and bit algorithms more clearly than a hand-written pair of shifts.
bitoperations-rotateleft.tips: A rotate is not an arithmetic shift; use it only when the algorithm specifies circular rotation.

vector128-create.title: Work with 128-bit SIMD values using Vector128<T>
vector128-create.short: Operate on several numeric lanes together
vector128-create.summary: Vector128<T> represents a 128-bit SIMD vector and supports operations across its lanes.
vector128-create.why: Measured numeric hot paths can sometimes process multiple elements per instruction.
vector128-create.tips: Start with correct scalar code, measure first, and verify hardware and type support before specializing.

half-binary16.title: Represent binary16 values with Half
half-binary16.short: Use a two-byte floating-point type where the format requires it
half-binary16.summary: Half represents an IEEE 754 binary16-style 16-bit floating-point value.
half-binary16.why: It makes boundaries such as ML tensors and binary formats that use half precision explicit.
half-binary16.tips: Half has much less range and precision than float; do not replace ordinary calculations with it blindly.

timespan-frommicroseconds.title: Create durations explicitly with TimeSpan.FromMicroseconds
timespan-frommicroseconds.short: Avoid hand-written unit conversion for microseconds
timespan-frommicroseconds.summary: FromMicroseconds constructs a TimeSpan from a value expressed in microseconds.
timespan-frommicroseconds.why: The unit is visible in code instead of being hidden in manual tick arithmetic.
timespan-frommicroseconds.tips: Use Stopwatch for measuring elapsed execution time and TimeSpan for representing a duration.

timezoneinfo-iana-windows.title: Convert IANA and Windows time-zone IDs with TimeZoneInfo
timezoneinfo-iana-windows.short: Handle the ID-system boundary across platforms
timezoneinfo-iana-windows.summary: TimeZoneInfo conversion helpers map between IANA and Windows time-zone identifiers when a mapping is available.
timezoneinfo-iana-windows.why: Cross-platform applications can avoid maintaining their own fragile mapping table.
timezoneinfo-iana-windows.tips: Handle conversion failure normally and choose one canonical ID system for persisted data.

cultureinfo-getcultureinfo.title: Reuse read-only cultures with CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo
cultureinfo-getcultureinfo.short: Get cached culture information when no customization is needed
cultureinfo-getcultureinfo.summary: GetCultureInfo returns a cached read-only CultureInfo for a requested culture name.
cultureinfo-getcultureinfo.why: Repeated read-only access does not need a fresh CultureInfo allocation every time.
cultureinfo-getcultureinfo.tips: The returned object is read-only; create a separate instance when customization is required.

immutablearray-builder.title: Build ImmutableArray values efficiently with a Builder
immutablearray-builder.short: Accumulate mutably, then publish an immutable array
immutablearray-builder.summary: ImmutableArray<T>.Builder supports repeated additions before producing an immutable array.
immutablearray-builder.why: It avoids repeatedly rebuilding immutable arrays during a construction phase.
immutablearray-builder.tips: Use it when the final value should be immutable; ordinary mutable collections remain simpler for mutable state.

priorityqueue-enqueue-dequeue.title: Combine priority-queue insertion and removal with EnqueueDequeue
priorityqueue-enqueue-dequeue.short: Update a fixed-size candidate heap in one operation
priorityqueue-enqueue-dequeue.summary: EnqueueDequeue inserts an element and returns the element with the minimum priority.
priorityqueue-enqueue-dequeue.why: Top-K style algorithms can express replacement of the current minimum directly.
priorityqueue-enqueue-dequeue.tips: PriorityQueue does not guarantee stable ordering for equal priorities.
